'''Gil Burtin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Gil resided in the [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While here, he would periodically process papers for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who wished to resign from their freelance piloting.

==Behind the scenes==
Gil Burtin is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the
[[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, players can talk to him to resign from their respective freelance squadron.
